dialogue.content: （お世話になります。本日はよろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for having me. I look forward to our session today.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ今日はありがとうございます。よろしくお願いいたします。)
dialogue.English: (Likewise, thank you. I'm looking forward to our session today.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。ご相談にいらしてくださり、ありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢と性別を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 45歳 女性よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I’m 45 and female. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日のご相談は、どんなことですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 娘が高校2年なのですが、友達があまり居なくて心配です
dialogue.English: My daughter is in her second year of high school, and I'm worried because she doesn't seem to have many friends.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。そのようなことでお悩みなのですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me. So that is what you're concerned about.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話できるところからで大丈夫です。友達が少ないと感じることで、具体的に、どのようなところがご心配ですか？
dialogue.English: You can start wherever you feel comfortable. Specifically, what aspects of her having few friends are worrying you?

dialogue.content: 女子はグループで固まるのですが、どこにも既に入りずらそうで、休日も友達に誘われず家に居てるのを見ていると、学校生活でも浮いているのではないかと心配です
dialogue.English: Girls tend to form tight groups, but it seems difficult for her to join any of the existing ones. When I see her at home on weekends without being invited out by friends, I worry that she might be isolated at school as well.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そう感じると不安な気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Feeling that way can understandably make you anxious.

dialogue.content: はい、高校になると学校の様子もあまり見れなので。
dialogue.English: Yes, once she's in high school, I can't really see what's going on at school anymore.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。中学校までと違って授業参観などもありませんからね。
dialogue.English: That's true. Unlike in middle school, there aren't events like class observations for parents.

dialogue.content: はい、あまりありませんね。
dialogue.English: Yes, there really aren't.

dialogue.content: ご心配になられるのも自然なことかと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's quite natural for you to be concerned.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I suppose so.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは高校1年生でしょうか？もしよろしければご年齢も教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Is your daughter a first-year high school student? If you don't mind, could you tell me her age as well?

dialogue.content: 高校2年生17歳です。
dialogue.English: She’s a second-year high school student, 17 years old.

dialogue.content: 高校２年生だったのですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see, a second-year student. Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.content: 中学までの娘さんの友人関係とかはいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: What were your daughter's friendships like up until middle school?

dialogue.content: 中学1年入った時にすぐに仲良くなった友達に急に無視されてそれで、学校行けなくなった時がありました。
dialogue.English: When she started her first year of middle school, a friend she had quickly become close with suddenly started ignoring her, and there was a time she couldn't go to school because of it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。大切なお話を聞かせていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing such a personal story with me.

dialogue.content: そういう時期があったと知っていると、母親として心配になりますよね。
dialogue.English: Knowing that she went through a period like that, it makes sense that you would worry as a mother.

dialogue.content: その時は泣きながら相談してくれました。
dialogue.English: At that time, she came to me crying and confided in me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。娘さんはお母さまを信頼してくれているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Your daughter really trusts you, doesn't she?

dialogue.content: まだ子どもだったので、泣くしか無かったんだと思います
dialogue.English: She was still a child then, so I think crying was the only way she could express herself.

dialogue.content: 娘さんの精一杯の気持ちを受け止めていたのですね。
dialogue.English: You accepted all the feelings she was pouring out.

dialogue.content: 母親として娘さんを大切に思っていらっしゃるのだなと伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: It's very clear how much you cherish your daughter as a mother.

dialogue.content: その時は全身で受け止めてしっかり聞きましたが、対応がそれで良かったかはわかりません。
dialogue.English: At that time, I listened with my whole being and tried to take it all in, but I'm not sure if I handled it the right way.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは涙を流されて相談をされて、お母さまはしっかり受け止めたのですね。お母さまが全身で受け止めたように娘さんも全力で気持ちを出し切ったかと思いますがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: So your daughter came to you in tears, and you fully accepted her feelings. Just as you embraced her with your whole being, I imagine she was also able to pour out all of her feelings. How does that resonate with you?

dialogue.content: どうでしょう、娘が、泣いていたので、撫でながらどうしたのと聞いて行ったのですが。1日休んで翌日からは登校しましたが、その子とは部活もクラスも一緒だったので、ずっと辛そうでした。
dialogue.English: I’m not sure. She was crying, so I gently stroked her while asking what was wrong. She took one day off and went back to school the next day, but because she was in the same club and class as that girl, she seemed to be struggling for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。娘さんは1日お休みになられて、その後自分で学校に通われることを選ばれたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So she took a day off, and then she chose to go back to school on her own.

dialogue.content: メンタルが上がったり下がったりはありましたが、学校はほぼ通っていましま
dialogue.English: She had her emotional ups and downs, but she attended school for the most part.

dialogue.content: 誰かに自分の気持ちをぶつけるのも、つらい経験をされてた後に学校に通われるのもとても強い行動だと思います。
dialogue.English: I think both opening up to someone about her feelings and continuing to go to school after such a painful experience are signs of great strength.

dialogue.content: その行動をとれたのは、お母さまという存在があったからだと思いますがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: I believe she was able to do that because you were there for her. How does that feel to you?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれませんね。とても繊細な子どもだと思います
dialogue.English: That might be true. I think she's a very sensitive child.

dialogue.content: そう感じるのですね。娘さんにとって、自分をしっかり受け止めて考えてくれるお母さまがいらっしゃるというのは、とても心強く、幸せなことかと思います。
dialogue.English: I see you feel that way. For your daughter, having a mother who fully accepts her and thinks about her must be very reassuring and a wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは繊細な方なので、お母さまが娘さんを大切に思われていることを知っていると思いますし、伝わっていると思います。
dialogue.English: Since your daughter is sensitive, I believe she knows how much you cherish her. I'm sure she feels it.

dialogue.content: だからこそ、娘さんはお母さまを信頼し、相談してくれたのかなと思いますがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: That's probably why she trusted you and confided in you. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。娘との仲はいいのですが。もう中学の時の様には全て打ち明けてくれないもこもあって、余計心配します。同学年女子より精神年齢が違うのか、あまり話が合わないと思っているようです。
dialogue.English: That's true. I have a good relationship with my daughter, but she doesn't open up about everything like she did in middle school, which makes me worry more. It seems she feels her mental age is different from other girls her age, and that she can't relate to their conversations.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。年齢と共に心も成長いきますよね。ちなみに、精神年齢が違うと感じるのはどんなところからですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's natural for the mind to mature with age. Out of curiosity, in what ways does she feel her mental age is different?

dialogue.content: 周りが子どもっぽく見えるんだと思います。楽しい事をなんとなくしてるだけ同級生と話が合わないみたいです。
dialogue.English: I think she sees those around her as childish. It seems she can't connect with her classmates, who are just having fun for the sake of it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。精神年齢が高いことはそれだけ大人な見方をしていて、無理に付き合う必要もないかと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. Having a higher mental age means she has a more mature perspective, and perhaps she doesn't need to force herself to fit in.

dialogue.content: 何故無理に付き合う必要が無いんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Why doesn't she need to force herself to fit in?

dialogue.content: 無理に合わせてもそれこそ、楽しくないのではと思います。いろんな考えを持つ人はたくさんいます。自然と価値観の合う人はおのずと出会うと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Because if she forces herself to conform, it likely won’t be enjoyable for her. There are many people with different ways of thinking, and I believe she will naturally meet people whose values align with hers.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ありませんが、お時間となってしましました。今日お話ししてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: I'm afraid our time is up for today. How do you feel after our conversation?

dialogue.content: わかりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I understand. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: また様子見ていきます
dialogue.English: I'll continue to keep an eye on her.

dialogue.content: (今日はありがとうございました。終了時間過ぎてますので終了お願いいたします。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. As the session time has passed, please conclude the session.)

dialogue.content: （終了時間が過ぎてしまい、申し訳ありません。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry for going over time. Thank you very much.)
